title: Plastic area limitations on combustible ground signs and wall signs.
officialText: On ground signs and wall signs permitted to be constructed of combustible materials, if the display surface does not exceed 300 square feet (27.9 m2), 50 percent of the display surface shall be permitted to be covered by approved plastic. If the area of a display surface exceeds 300 square feet (27.9 m2), the area occupied or covered by approved plastics shall be limited to 150 square feet (13.9 m2) plus 25 percent of the difference between 150 square feet (13.9 m2) and the total area of display surface. The area of plastic on a display surface shall not in any case exceed 575 square feet (53.4 m2), unless approved by the commissioner.
